title: Ship the local registry and review foundation
body: Local registry and review are implemented. Remaining release evidence: installed packages, real agent sessions, and live-account behavior. See docs/roadmap.md.

title: Capture exact PR revisions with project adapters
body: Shared recipes support exact revisions, browser capture, and Apple native capture. Remaining: non-Apple native adapters and native fixture adapters. Preserve immutable evidence and stale-head detection.

title: Add versioned project configuration and coverage
body: Version 1 recipes, source relationships, readiness, and scoped coverage are implemented. Remaining: broader discovery, screen metadata updates, and rename lineage.

title: Package and validate Screens skills for Claude and Codex
body: Skills and client profiles are packaged. Remaining: real-client load, compare, and fix evidence. Keep workflow installation separate from model-session proof.

title: Coordinate agents with expiring claims
body: Task claims, renewal, expiry, pagination, and scoped queries are implemented. Retain revision checks and ownership conflicts.

title: Migrate review history and export portable reviews
body: Portable bundles are implemented. Remaining: review-history migration and explicit reconfirmation when feedback moves to a new capture.

title: Add visual differences and semantic verification evidence
body: Pixel differences, semantic evidence, browser collectors, OCR, and CI reports are implemented. Remaining: richer motion playback and perceptual measures. Human acceptance stays separate.

title: Add authenticated shared hosting and job dispatch
body: Local jobs and storage are implemented. Hosted operation still needs authenticated actors, project authorization, remote storage, and worker trust boundaries. Keep the service local until those exist.
